audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander makes Master Yi immune to all slowing effects, and neither the spikes, the whys, early, mid nor late mention it. Two of those sections build their advice on mushroom zoning ('your shrooms zone his approach paths', 'shroom his splitpush routes').
audit.why: Noxious Trap's whole zoning function is its slow. While Highlander is up, mushrooms still damage him but they no longer slow him at all, so the shroom net stops being a wall and becomes only a damage-over-time field he walks through at full speed. Every 'shrooms zone him' instruction in this entry silently assumes an effect that is switched off for the exact window it matters.
audit.corrected: Mushrooms slow him only while Highlander is down. With it up they are damage and vision, nothing more — plan the fight around the 85s cooldown, not around the trap field.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json (R Highlander: 'making him immune to all slowing effects', cd 85)

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Blinding Dart switches off his autos entirely' is stated at level 1 and repeated as the entire early-game thesis, with no mention that Alpha Strike is untargetable and deals ability damage.
audit.why: Blind genuinely is the best answer in the game to Yi — his damage is Double Strike, Wuju Style's true damage and Highlander's attack speed, all riding on basic attacks. But Alpha Strike is the hole in it: it is ability damage, so it hits through the blind, and he is untargetable for its duration, so a Teemo who tries to dart him mid-Alpha-Strike simply loses the cast. The entry sells the blind as total and never names its one exception.
audit.corrected: Blind switches off everything except Alpha Strike, which goes through it and makes him untargetable while it runs.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json (Q Alpha Strike: 'becoming untargetable'; E Wuju Style: true damage on basic attacks; P Double Strike)

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike's cooldown is reduced by Master Yi's basic attacks, and nothing says so.
audit.why: It is the second, compounding payoff of every blind you land. Alpha Strike starts at 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 seconds — enormous — and only comes down when his attacks connect. Blinding his attack window therefore keeps his one gap-closer and one untargetability window on a near-twenty-second timer. That is the mechanism behind 'the blind resets each attempt' in whys[3], which currently asserts the effect without the cause.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike is ~20s at rank 1 and only ticks down off landed basic attacks. Blind the attacks and the dash stays gone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/masteryi.json (Q Alpha Strike, cd 20/19.5/19/18.5/18: 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown')

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is never mentioned. It heals, reduces damage taken, and pauses the remaining duration on both Wuju Style and Highlander while it channels.
audit.why: The duration pause is the non-obvious half: a Yi who Meditates mid-fight is not retreating, he is banking his ultimate timer, so 'wait out his ult' does not work the way a player would assume. The heal is also the anti-heal target flagged for this matchup, and the entry recommends no Grievous Wounds anywhere.
audit.corrected: Meditate heals him, cuts incoming damage, and freezes the clocks on Wuju Style and Highlander. Grievous Wounds is a real purchase here, not a luxury.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wuju Style's true damage is not mentioned, and neither layer discusses resistances for this matchup.
audit.why: It means stacking MR or armour does not buy safety against his attack damage the way it would against most duellists — but it also means blind is the resistance, because true damage on a basic attack is still damage on a basic attack. That reframing is what makes the blind-first plan correct rather than merely convenient.
audit.corrected: Wuju Style is true damage on his attacks, so resistances do not answer it. Blind does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander's cooldown (85s) is never given, nor the fact that champion kills and assists extend its duration and reduce his other cooldowns.
audit.why: 85 seconds is short for an ultimate and it is the clock the whole late game runs on. The extension-on-takedown clause is why a Yi who gets one pick in a teamfight arrives at the next objective with everything up — which is the actual reason the two-item stage flips to him, rather than raw stats.
audit.corrected: Highlander is 85s, extends on every takedown, and refunds his other cooldowns on takedown too.

audit.why: 50.0% over 338 games, and the content chart reads Teemo-Teemo-Teemo-Skill-Skill-Yi-Yi, which is an honest shape for a matchup that is a hard early bully and a hard late loss. I have no correction to make to the chart on this one.

edits.after: You bully the first three levels: Blinding Dart switches off Double Strike and Wuju Style's true damage, since both ride on basic attacks. Alpha Strike is the exception — ability damage, and untargetable while it runs, so never dart him mid-dash. Starve his farm; every denied wave delays his spike.
